events.title: Isaias strengthens to become first Atlantic hurricane of 2026 season
events.description: Storm expected to make landfall on US’s northern Gulf coast with risk of flash floods and isolated river flooding Isaias has become the first Atlantic hurricane of the 2026 season, with wind speeds of 80mph and a minimum pressure of 975mb. It is expected to strengthen to a category 2 hurricane as it approaches the US’s northern Gulf coast on Friday, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA). As a result of the strong El Niño , it has been a notably quiet Atlantic hurricane season. The first hurricane of the season has not formed this late since 8 October 1905, which pre-dates the satellite era (1960s) for tracking hurricanes that has allowed for more non-landfall hurricanes to be discovered. events.title: How will a diesel deal with Russia impact the U.S. market?

events.title: Trump's diesel deal with Putin angers Europe
events.description: President Trump's diesel deal with Russia sparks European fury, as Ukraine's President Zelenskyy questions Washington's motives and allies vow to keep pressure on Moscow.

events.title: DNA and vehicle-tracking help French investigators recover stolen Renoirs
events.description: DNA left on a protective painting cover helped investigators recover two stolen Renoirs and uncover what they suspected were preparations for another art heist, a French prosecutor said Monday.

events.title: Many Iranians who go to Turkey to find jobs are exploited
events.description: Desperate Iranians are finding work in Turkey to make ends meet, but many are being exploited and left with nothing but more debt.

events.title: Both Russia and Ukraine are using AI-powered drones on the battlefield
events.description: A Ukrainian company that got rich making smartphone-controlled cameras to watch pets at home now outfits first-person-view drones with an image recognition system powered by artificial intelligence.

events.title: Cornell suspends frat parties after gang rape case
events.description: Cornell said no parties will be held at frat houses until the end of the academic year. The university is trying to mend its reputation following its handling of a gang rape case in 2024.

events.title: Tupac Shakur murder trial: Former gang leader Duane Davis sentenced to 40 years

events.title: Germany news: Left-leaning Berlin coalition talks break down
events.description: The SPD and Greens in Berlin have halted exploratory coalition talks with the Left Party amid a dispute over Israel policy and antisemitism. DW has more.

events.title: Ukraine and the US: What's next after Trump's diesel deal with Russia?
events.description: Donald Trump plans to allow the purchase of Russian diesel, drawing criticism at home and abroad. What is behind the US president’s decision and what should Ukraine do next? DW spoke with experts.

events.title: Hungary's parliament votes to reverse anti-LGBTQ legislation from Orban era
events.description: Hungary's parliament passed a bill amending the 2021 "child protection law." The move is considered the first significant reversal of Orban's curbs targeting the LGBTQ+ community.

events.title: Spain's King Felipe and Queen Letizia visit Ceuta
events.description: The royal couple have arrived for their first-ever visit to the exclave to show solidarity with residents.

events.title: Arsenal thrash Lille as Atletico Madrid beat Manchester United

Bayern Munich were held to a shock 3-3 draw by Norway’s Viking after Michael Olise was sent off.

events.title: Former gang leader sentenced to 40 years to life for Tupac Shakur murder
events.description: Duane “Keffe D” Davis, the former Los Angeles gang leader who boasted in books and interviews of his involvement in the killing of rapper Tupac Shakur, only to deny it when he came to trial, was sentenced to a minimum 40 years in prison on Tuesday.

events.title: Cancer found after Pope had part of his lung removed during 'successful' surgery
events.description: The Pope has undergone surgery to treat lung cancer.

events.title: Formula One to return to Africa for first time in 30 years

events.description: Metallica Rose Harrison allegedly stabbed her husband and toddler at a Great Wolf Lodge in Pennsylvania before telling responders about her "happy family."
